name: Fody Foods Shallot-Infused Extra Virgin Olive Oil (True Onion Aroma)
whyItWorks: Captures rich sweet shallot and onion aroma in extra virgin olive oil while leaving all gas-producing allium fructans behind. Allows IBD patients to enjoy authentic onion flavor in soups, rice, and stews with zero bloating or cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sauté vegetables and meats with shallot oil as a direct drop-in replacement for diced onions.
